# FP-Ops interface reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_api_reference.py. -->

All names below are installed top-level exports from `fp_ops`.

## `BuildFieldError`

```python
BuildFieldError(field: 'str', cause: 'Exception') -> 'None'
```

A schema field failed while being built.

## `CollectionOperation`

A unary `Operation` returned by collection combinators. Its overloads preserve iterable-to-list and mapping-to-dictionary shapes through execution and composition.

## `Continue`

```python
Continue(state: 'S_co') -> None
```

Run another ``loop`` step with ``state``.

## `Derived`

```python
Derived(operation: 'Operation[DA, DT]') -> 'None'
```

A template operand read from the pipeline input at run time.

## `EMPTY_ENV`

`from fp_ops import EMPTY_ENV`

A read-only mapping from typed identity keys to values.

## `EnvKey`

```python
EnvKey(name: 'str', value_type: 'type[T]') -> 'None'
```

An identity key carrying the runtime type of one environment value.

## `Environment`

```python
Environment(values: 'Mapping[EnvKey[object], object] | None' = None) -> 'None'
```

A read-only mapping from typed identity keys to values.

## `EnvironmentError`

`from fp_ops import EnvironmentError`

Raised when an environment is missing a key or holds the wrong type.

```python
ErrorFilter(*args, **kwargs)
```

## `Fanout`

A fail-fast parallel `Operation[A, tuple[...]]` built with `&`. `a & b & c` returns a flat `(a, b, c)` tuple; an operand that returns a tuple, or a parenthesized right-hand `&`, stays one branch.

## `LoopStepError`

```python
LoopStepError(step: 'int', state: 'T', cause: 'Exception') -> 'None'
```

A ``loop`` step failed; ``state`` is that step's input, so work can resume.

`from fp_ops import MISSING`

## `Operation`

Construct with a unary constructor, a configured operation template, or another FP-Ops combinator.

```python
run(self, value: 'A_contra', *, environment: 'Environment' = Environment()) -> 'Result[B_co, Exception]'
```

```python
then(self: 'Operation[A, list[T]]', next: 'CollectionOperation[T, C]') -> 'Operation[A, list[C]]'
then(self: 'Operation[A, Mapping[K, T]]', next: 'CollectionOperation[T, C]') -> 'Operation[A, dict[K, C]]'
then(self, next: 'Operation[B_co, C]') -> 'Operation[A_contra, C]'
```

```python
map(self, fn: 'Callable[[B_co], C | Awaitable[C]]') -> 'Operation[A_contra, C]'
```

```python
flat_map(self, fn: 'Callable[[B_co], Operation[Unit, C] | Awaitable[Operation[Unit, C]]]', *, requires: 'Iterable[EnvKey[Any]]' = ()) -> 'Operation[A_contra, C]'
```

## `operation_template`

```python

def configured(...): ...

stage: Operation[A, B] = configured(..., _, ...)
```
